en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide tree‑lined avenue with benches on both sides, bordered by tall trees and palm trees, in a landscaped park. The top has red printed text identifying the scene as a palm‑tree street in Campo Grande, Lisbon. At the lower left there is an ornate publisher's mark, and at the bottom in red appears the word "Portugal" followed by a card number.
